audit.framing_9x16: Top half facecam, bottom half gameplay. Clean vertical split with occasional full facecam takeovers for punchlines.
audit.subtitle_craft: Minimalist white bold font centered on screen, updating dynamically word by word with simple black stroke for high readability.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Subtle push-ins on CaseOh's face during intense rants and comedic realization moments to emphasize expressions.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Comedic sound effects (*fork noise*, *rumbling*) inserted at exact punchline timestamps to amplify the joke.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Rapid-fire montage ranking 5 distinct moments, each cut precisely after the punchline lands without lingering.
standout_techniques: Dynamic numbered vertical ranking list on the left side of the screen
Precise SFX punctuation on comedic moments (*fork noise*, *rumbling*)
Split-screen layout pairing facecam reactions directly with corresponding gameplay
Quick-cut pacing between entirely different game clips
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Slightly generic top banner title that stays static throughout the whole video
